purpose: Make NO-BUY denominator observable without changing Formal selection, monitoring eligibility, signals, push, capital or trading rules.

rowCompletenessContract.pagination: deterministic stable keyset/cursor; totalMatchingRows measured before page truncation
rowCompletenessContract.noRowsRule: zero returned rows alone is UNKNOWN unless expected-event completeness positively proves zero expected rows

rules: Cron/monitor SUCCESS is not recorder SUCCESS.
An expected symbol omitted because result.ok=false must be counted/skipped with a named reason; it cannot disappear.
NO_EVENT is valid only when the complete run receipt proves zero expected events.
Receipt and rows must refer to the same tradeDate/runId clock.
